title: Hatsune Miku — Shiny Smiley Magic〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Miku?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's rare to see you staring off into space like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't have anything to do after putting on that show for Tsukasa and the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Miku. Maybe I shouldn't have suggested we all take a break after working so hard on our show...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, it's important for us to take breaks when we can! You did nothing wrong, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so bored...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we chat about something together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I was just thinking about organizing the props since I also don't have much else to do at the mo—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wait, KAITO, that's actual work!
You shouldn't be doing that!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's sort of my point. I figured I'd talk to you instead. So, how about it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay☆ Let's talk about stuff!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, what do you wanna talk about?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We talked quite a lot about the show we did for Tsukasa and the others after it finished, so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know. Can you tell me more about you-but-not-you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Come here, KAITO!
Sit next to me! Hurry♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you. Then, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You had such a surprised look on your face after you said you'd met her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ Because nothing like that had ever happened to me before♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO!
Do you think she's the Miku you met that time?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm... I'm not sure.
I only caught a brief glimpse of her. And she looked...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She looked much paler compared to the Miku you described.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, that means every SEKAI really does have totally different versions of us in it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's because this SEKAI was born out of the others' feelings. We were as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, what those feelings entail can greatly affect how a SEKAI and our counterparts look.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. We really are an interesting bunch☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, we certainly are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, me-but-not-me also said she's been watching all our shows!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She even said that she felt really encouraged by them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's wonderful to hear!
We should be proud as actors.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. We ended up talking a lot☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The more we talk about them, the more our various encounters begin feeling odd or uncanny.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do you think our counterparts are doing in their respective SEKAI right now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They might be talking to each other and having fun like us♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. That'd be nice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you think I'll ever see that other me again?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't say for sure...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd also like to speak with our counterparts from the other SEKAI again, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't know if that will ever happen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm guessing that we were able to at all because our feelings were in perfect sync.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, but I remember someone saying...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “What happens twice will happen thrice”!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. It's happened twice already, so a third time doesn't seem out of the question.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Exactly♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope we get to talk lots and lots more next time.
